zh: 臺灣棒球隊搭星宇航空JX800赴日，AIRSORAYAMA GOLD藝術機執飛。

en: Aviation briefs: Boeing to Cut About 5% of Commercial Airplane Workforce as Output Slows; Philippine Airlines launches first nonstop Manila–Chicago service: near-17-hour westbound leg, three weekly A350 flights
